title: Tutoring Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for tutoring that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Tutoring Permission Slip Form supports the complete tutoring workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Tutoring Permission Slip Form when the assigned tutoring coordinator needs one fillable record for learner goals, session routing, academic evidence, support, and release without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Tutoring permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one learner goals, session routing, academic evidence, support, and release record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Tutoring record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Tutoring scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Tutoring requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: Tutoring permission choices
items: Participation in the named tutoring subject and session window
Use of listed school or guardian-provided learning materials
Communication through the documented guardian or school route
Use of approved academic and accessibility supports
Remote or off-site session only when separately described
Emergency contact through supplied routing information
Departure only through the documented release plan
Declined optional activities recorded separately
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records tutoring operations; it does not diagnose learning needs, change a school plan, promise academic outcomes, decide custody, or replace emergency services. Stop or escalate when identity, guardian or school direction, approved support, release, privacy, or safety is unresolved. Record objective learning evidence and route educational or professional decisions to authorized qualified reviewers.

sections.title: Tutoring guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Learner, tutor, subject, or session assignment is unclear
Guardian or school contact route is unavailable
Requested goal exceeds the tutoring program scope
Approved academic or accessibility support is unavailable
Learner is missing, distressed, ill, injured, or needs immediate support
Private school record or personal information is exposed
Pickup, independent departure, or virtual-session identity is unclear
Attendance, progress evidence, or follow-up record does not reconcile

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: Tutoring permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: Tutoring permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the tutoring coordinator, guardian or school contact, and qualified support reviewer.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: Tutoring permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Tutoring assignment or session cannot proceed as planned
Guardian, school, emergency contact, or release route is incomplete
Academic goal or requested service exceeds program authority
Approved accommodation, technology, or support is unavailable
Immediate illness, distress, missing-learner, or safety response is active
Attendance, progress, departure, or follow-up remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: Tutoring outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Tutoring closeout controls
items: Session attendance and learning evidence accepted
Guardian or school communication status recorded
Unresolved academic or support action has an owner
Equipment and private student records returned
Schedule, technology, or program follow-up linked
Tutoring record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
